page.content:
Deepest ocean trench, east of the Mariana Islands.

How Mariana Trench connects

  • Location: Challenger Deep — Challenger Deep is the deepest surveyed point of the Mariana Trench.
  • Event: Challenger expedition — Challenger sounded the deep that became Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench.
  • Topic: Seafloor spreading — Trenches consume the crust that ridges create in the spreading cycle.

What is Mariana Trench?

The Mariana Trench is a Pacific subduction trough whose Challenger Deep is the lowest surveyed point in the world ocean.

Key threads lead to Challenger Deep, Challenger expedition and Seafloor spreading.
